SASBDB entry SASDZC6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDZC6/)

Publication: A highly dynamic active state for transducin-bound phosphodiesterase-6 in vertebrate phototransduction (bioRxiv preprint)
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.01.715611

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDZC6/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
